snippet.title: Crathos Deep - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Descend down the arctic depths in Crathos Deep, a cosmic horror narrative adventure. Explore the vast abyss with your submarine and utilize your expeditionary drone to reach the dark corners of the ocean. Investigate a lost research institute to unravel the unsettling mystery of its downfall.

Wishlist Crathos Deep Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3259000/Crathos_Deep
